svg.title: You write down what should be true
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “You write down what should be true” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A six-step numbered chain from kubectl apply through the API server into etcd, out to the controllers and scheduler and down to the kubelet, with a struck-out ssh-and-docker-run shortcut beside it, next to a large dashed reconciliation loop whose four stations are desired state, observe actual, diff and act; below, an honest four-row decision table ending in Kubernetes only for many services across many teams, and five broken-pod boxes labelled ImagePullBackOff, OOMKilled, CrashLoopBackOff, CreateContainerConfigError and Pending Insufficient cpu.
svg.text: You write down what should be true
draw it from memory, then compare
